head: c20c1c8

smoke.notes: Core ranch modules parse clean. Test suites NOT_RUN: tests/test-all.js + integration tests target a Worker/runtime harness not present offline; live instances are remote URLs (out of scope, no network). craftmind-study is a STUDY of three sibling repos (ranch, researcher, herding) held under the my-project workspace repo (toplevel /home/z/my-project, HEAD c20c1c8); each sibling is self-contained (zero deps, Cloudflare Worker deployable).

essence: study of three sibling Cocapn-fleet experiments where learning is emergent and verified-work-only: evolving ranch bots, a blank-slate researcher, correction-trained sheepdogs

ideas.name: evolution on verified work only
ideas.statement: craftmind-ranch runs populations of Minecraft bots whose heritable DNA adapts through breeding — with fitness awarded solely for verified, completed in-game work, never for attempting: 'No proxy rewards', you are the curator, not the trainer.

ideas.name: the blank-slate researcher
ideas.statement: craftmind-researcher starts with an empty rulebook and learns Minecraft mechanics by identifying gaps in its own knowledge graph, designing single-variable A/B experiments, and requiring reproducible, citation-backed results before a fact enters the knowledge base.

ideas.name: learning from the fence line
ideas.statement: craftmind-herding trains border-collie agents with no commands and no training data: you correct behavior from the fence line, dogs coordinate solely through movement (no explicit communication), and five skill tiers (Apprentice to Elder) grant small permanent stat adjustments.

ideas.name: fork-first isolation
ideas.statement: All three siblings are fork-first: every fork is a separate evolutionary lineage ('No two ranches will produce identical bots'), deployed as a single Cloudflare Worker with zero dependencies — divergence is the product, not a bug.

ideas.name: budgets shape cognition
ideas.statement: Hard limits are stated as design forces: herding agents must reason in under 10ms of Worker CPU (8-10 agents max practical), and the ranch's evolution pace is tied to the game's task submission rate ('if no tasks are completed... evolution stalls') — constraints are published, not hidden.

parts.name: heritable DNA blueprints
parts.essence: Each bot is a JSON DNA: species traits, personality, taskWeights (0.7-1.0 for preferred tasks), learningRate (0.1-0.3), mutationRate (0.1-0.25), per-task confidence map, generation and parentIds — eight species with distinct behavioral biases.
parts.failure_mode: hardcoded behavior paths (explicitly rejected: 'no hardcoded paths')
parts.evidence: craftmind-study/craftmind-ranch/src/dna.js createDNA() as read; data/default-dna/ (mooshroom, duck, trufflehog, falcon, shepherd, goat, rooster, stallion)

parts.name: breed + mutate on success
parts.essence: Successful bots breed, combining DNA with small random mutations; fitness is awarded only for verified completed work; populations compete for the jobs you provide.
parts.failure_mode: selection on proxy signals (attempts, appearances) instead of completions
parts.evidence: craftmind-study/craftmind-ranch/src/evolution-engine.js (module present, parse-checked); README 'Successful bots breed, combining their DNA with small random mutations'

parts.name: no-proxy-reward rule
parts.essence: Fitness is awarded solely for completing a task, not for attempting it — the study's sharpest policy: the only currency is verified work.
outputs: fitness credit only on verified completion

parts.name: task-confidence permanent boost
parts.essence: A bot permanently improves its speed at a task by ~8% each time it succeeds — confidence accumulates per taskId inside the DNA (confidence: taskId -> 0..1).
outputs: permanent speed increment on that task
parts.failure_mode: unbounded compounding turning repetition into invincibility
parts.evidence: craftmind-ranch/README.md 'A bot permanently improves its speed at a task by 8% each time it succeeds'; dna.js confidence field

parts.name: soft population caps
parts.essence: Soft caps keep turnover in the population — space is made for new genomes rather than a frozen elite.
parts.gate: population stays under the soft cap, oldest/weakest make room
parts.evidence: craftmind-ranch/README.md 'Key Features' item 'Soft population caps to encourage turnover'

parts.name: empty knowledge graph substrate
parts.essence: The researcher starts with no game knowledge: knowledge/ holds initial-facts.json, citations.json, building-techniques.json, meta-learner-state.json — a graph that grows only from its own experiments.
parts.failure_mode: pre-programmed rulebooks (explicitly rejected: 'Most Minecraft agents operate from a complete, pre-programmed rulebook')

parts.name: gap -> single-variable experiment
parts.essence: The loop: identify gaps or contradictions in the graph, design a controlled experiment that changes only one variable at a time, run it, analyze for statistical consistency.
parts.evidence: craftmind-researcher/README.md 'How It Works' (identifies gaps, 'controlled experiments that change only one variable at a time')

parts.name: reproducibility-before-fact rule
parts.essence: Results must be reproducible before a conclusion enters the knowledge base, and every learned fact logs citations to its source experiment data.
parts.gate: a fact enters the KB only with reproducible results + experiment citation
parts.evidence: craftmind-researcher/README.md 'Requires reproducible results before accepting a finding. Logs every learned fact with citations'

parts.name: multi-agent research chain
parts.essence: The researcher is organized as specialist agents: discovery-agent, critic-agent, distiller-agent, teacher-agent, peer-review-system, hypothesis-tracker, experiment-validator, literature-review — peer review as code.
parts.failure_mode: a single agent grading its own homework
parts.evidence: craftmind-researcher/src/ file listing (critic-agent.js, peer-review-system.js, hypothesis-tracker.js, experiment-validator.js, meta-learner.js)

parts.name: boids flock + personality matrix
parts.essence: Sheep run a tuned boids algorithm (panic, tire, cluster); each dog has a six-axis personality (Speed, Patience, Obedience, Social, Bravery, Gentleness); weather affects visibility and movement; five standard courses.
parts.evidence: craftmind-herding/README.md 'Personality Matrix' + 'Flock Simulation' + 'Environmental Effects'; src/flock-simulation.js, src/dog-personalities.js

parts.name: correction-driven tier ascent
parts.essence: You never give commands — you correct behavior from the fence line; agents learn only from interactions and outcomes during their own runtime, crossing five skill tiers (Apprentice to Elder) with small permanent stat adjustments.
outputs: tier promotions with permanent stat deltas
parts.failure_mode: pre-trained models or uploaded datasets (explicitly: 'No Pre-Trained Models')

parts.name: emergent-only teamwork rule
parts.essence: Dogs coordinate solely through movement and positioning; no explicit communication is programmed — teamwork must appear, not be declared.
parts.failure_mode: smuggling in a comms channel would void the emergence claim
parts.evidence: craftmind-herding/README.md 'Emergent Teamwork: Dogs coordinate solely through movement and positioning; no explicit communication is programmed'

parts.name: fork-first lineage isolation
parts.essence: Development is fork-first across all three repos: every fork is a separate evolutionary lineage with its own Worker deployment; no two ranches produce identical bots; contributions return via PR.
parts.failure_mode: shared training state leaking between forks
parts.evidence: craftmind-ranch/README.md 'What Makes This Different' item 3 + 'Contributing' ('Development is fork-first'); same pattern stated in researcher and herding READMEs

parts.name: published budget ceilings
parts.essence: Constraints are published as design forces: the herding reasoning loop must finish in <10ms Worker CPU (8-10 agents max practical), and ranch evolution stalls without task completions — the study records limits as features.
parts.gate: agent reasoning loop completes in <10ms CPU
parts.failure_mode: hiding the ceiling until users hit it
parts.evidence: craftmind-herding/README.md 'Limitations' ('under 10ms of CPU time... 8-10 agents'); craftmind-ranch/README.md 'One Specific Limitation'

parts.name: watchable live instances
parts.essence: Each sibling runs as a public live instance (the-fleet.casey-digennaro.workers.dev/ranch) with scripts/playtest.js — 'You watch evolution do farm work', 'watch populations evolve, export generation data, or fork your own ranch in about two minutes': the interface is observation itself.
outputs: a session a human can watch and steer
parts.failure_mode: an evolution story nobody can watch run
parts.evidence: craftmind-ranch/README.md live-instance link + 'Live instance' framing; scripts/playtest.js present in all three siblings

parts.name: test trios + roadmap receipts
parts.essence: Each sibling ships a test trio (test-all.js, test-ai.js, integration.test.js) and a ROADMAP.md — the study's repos carry their own verification and declared future, even as zero-dependency Workers.
parts.failure_mode: emergence claims with no runnable verification
parts.evidence: craftmind-ranch/tests/ (test-all.js, test-ai.js, integration.test.js) + ROADMAP.md; same trio present in craftmind-researcher/ and craftmind-herding/

cells.expr: empty knowledge graph, facts cite experiments

layer_logic.0: substrate = three mutable memory structures: bot DNA, an empty cited knowledge graph, and a boids flock with personality axes
layer_logic.1: mechanism = breed+mutate on verified success, gap-driven single-variable experiments, correction-driven tier ascent
layer_logic.2: policy = no proxy rewards, reproducibility-before-fact, emergent-only teamwork, fork-first lineages, published budget ceilings
layer_logic.3: interface = live Worker instances you watch (ranch/researcher/herding), playtest scripts, task-submission flow
layer_logic.4: evidence = per-repo test trios + playtest.js + public live instances — the learning is offered observable, not asserted
